title: Randomized, Two-Cohort, Open-Label, Phase 3 Clinical Trial of N-803 Plus Tislelizumab or Prior Failed Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor and Docetaxel Versus Docetaxel Monotherapy in Participants With Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer who Have Acquired Resistance to Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy.
official: Randomized, Two-Cohort, Open-Label, Phase 3 Clinical Trial of N-803 Plus Tislelizumab or Prior Failed Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor and Docetaxel Versus Docetaxel Monotherapy in Participants With Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer who Have Acquired Resistance to Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy.
summary: Main objective: The principle research objective is to compare overall survival (OS) between the experimental and control arms.
conditions: Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

interventions.name: LIBTAYO 350 mg concentrate for solution for infusion.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Subjects of both sexes can participate in this study if they: • are over 18 years old; • have confirmed stage 4 non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC); • have developed resistance to their cancer treatment or their condition has progressed after receiving immunotherapy in combination with platinum-based chemotherapy; • have measurable tumor lesions; • can move around and take care of themselves; • agree to use an effective contraceptive method (women of childbearing age and non-sterile men).
Exclusion criteria:
1. Please refer to the protocol. Due to a character limit of 4000, updated exclusion criteria cannot be entered in this field.
